en.t: The Emperor was very wise and discerning at heart.

units.source_text: 他相信日本相术，看到这小皇子的相貌，早就胸有成竹，所以一直不曾封他为亲王。

en.t: He believed in Japanese physiognomy, and after seeing the little prince's features he had long since made up his mind, so he had never granted him the rank of imperial prince.

units.source_text: 现在他见这朝鲜相士之言和他自己见解相吻合，觉得此人实甚高明，便下决心：

en.t: Now, seeing that the Korean physiognomist's words matched his own view, he thought the man truly perceptive and made his decision:

units.source_text: “我一定不让他做个没有外戚作后援的无品亲王[\[23\]](#part1330.html#m23)，免得他坎坷终身。

en.t: "I must not let him become an unranked imperial prince without maternal relatives to support him, lest he suffer hardships all his life.

units.source_text: 我在位几年，也是说不定的。

en.t: It is uncertain how many more years I will remain on the throne.

units.source_text: 我还不如让他做个臣下，教他辅佐朝廷。

en.t: It would be better for me to make him a subject and have him serve the court.

units.source_text: 为他将来打算，这也是得策的。”

en.t: Considering his future, this is also the wiser course."

units.source_text: 从此就教他研究有关此道的种种学问。

en.t: From then on, he had the boy study the various branches of learning connected with that path.

units.source_text: 小皇子研究学问之后，才华更加焕发了。

en.t: After the little prince pursued these studies, his brilliance shone even more brightly.

units.source_text: 教这人屈居臣下之位，实甚可惜。

en.t: It was truly a pity to make such a person remain in the position of a subject.

units.source_text: 然而如果封他为亲王，必然招致世人疑忌，反而不利。

en.t: Yet if he were made an imperial prince, it would surely arouse people's suspicion and resentment, and would instead work against him.

units.source_text: 再教精通命理的人推算一下，见解相同。

en.t: When he further had someone skilled in fate calculation make a prediction, the conclusion was the same.

units.source_text: 于是皇上就将这小皇子降为臣籍，赐姓源氏。

en.t: Thus the Emperor reduced the little prince to subject status and bestowed on him the surname Genji.
